sam (marketing lead): Planning note: webinar + 1-pager + battlecard refresh. Primary narrative: predictable inference economics + predictable latency vs cloud managed endpoints. Need hooks and A/B subject lines.
ellie (demand gen): For subject lines, let's test urgency vs benefit. A: 'Stop surprise AI bills: predictable inference for production' B: 'How we cut latency spikes and invoice shock for product teams'
omar (product marketing): Add a claim cluster for the slide: 1) predictable spend (reserved vs variable), 2) SLA-driven availability & graceful degradation, 3) privacy/controls (VPC + KMS + audit trail). Each with 1-line proof + 1 customer stat.
ravi (benchmarks): I'll provide the numbers. Drafting a micro-benchmark: median p99 latency @ seq=512, $/1M tokens at median throughput, failover recovery (s) across regions. Plan to benchmark: CloudProviderX managed endpoint, LLM-API-Z, Redwood Dedicated.
zoe (sales enablement): For the battlecard: top 5 competitor claims and quick rebuttals. Example claim: 'Cloud managed endpoints scale elastically and are cheaper.' rebuttal: 'Elasticity is great for bursty training workloads; for steady inference, reserved pools + model variants yield lower, predictable unit costs and simpler procurement.' add 1-sentence script for SDRs.
ellie (demand gen): Webinar format: 20m talk (prod marketing + bench) + 15m live Q&A (sales + solutions). CTA: gated one-pager with downloadable cost calc template.
omar (product marketing): Soundbite bank for slide deck: 1) "Predictable capacity, predictable invoices." 2) "Fallbacks first: we fail gracefully, not silently." 3) "Same API across hosted, dedicated, private."
ravi (benchmarks): Uploading draft CSV with raw numbers to /drive/marketing/benchmarks/webinar-bench-draft.csv now. asset-bot: New file uploaded: /drive/marketing/benchmarks/webinar-bench-draft.csv :paperclip:
zoe (sales enablement): Request: give me 3 micro-rebuttals for calls that include a single stat each. e.g., 'Reserved usage cut token spend variability by 23% in ProdFin case.'
omar (product marketing): Will draft. Also include a legal-friendly line: 'we can support customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and audit logs' for procurement.
ellie (demand gen): Also want two webinar hooks for promotion: Hook A (tech buyers): 'How we keep inference predictable at scale' Hook B (product leaders): 'Avoid surprise bills and latency regressions for customer-facing features'
sam (marketing lead): Good. Timeline: slides + battlecard copy by Tue EOD, bench numbers finalized Wed AM, AB lines loaded in send test Wed noon. Zoe run a 30-min enablement roleplay Thu. Thumbs if this works. :thumbsup:
